summary: Koreksi is now converted with Math.abs before payroll gross/tax/bruto calculations so both 10 and -10 reduce wages by 10.
Excel deduction cells now store signed negative values and formulas add those signed cells, avoiding double-negative transformations.
Daftar Upah Excel includes pendapatan lainnya detail columns under Upah Kotor and Potongan Upah Bersih, matching the web behavior more closely.
Payslip and tax display code formats deductions from absolute magnitudes to avoid duplicate minus signs and sign inversions.
Full cross-source reconciliation needs representative employee-period data; current execution verified code paths and regression tests only.
Frontend build passes; Vite still reports an existing summaryReportService dynamic/static import chunking warning.
